story.title: Trump's PAC Invests in Darline Graham Ahead of South Carolina Runoff
story.summary: MAGA Inc., a super PAC associated with Donald Trump, has made a significant investment of over $827,000 in voter outreach for Darline Graham in her South Carolina runoff election. This comes as Graham seeks to retain her brother's Senate seat amidst a challenging political landscape, where Trump's endorsement record is under scrutiny following several gubernatorial losses this cycle. Some Trump supporters remain skeptical about Graham's candidacy as the runoff approaches.

related_stories.title: Supreme Court Allows Trump to Move Forward with Mail Voting Restrictions
related_stories.summary: The Supreme Court has granted a 6-3 decision allowing the Trump administration to proceed with parts of an executive order aimed at restricting mail voting. This order includes the creation of 'state citizenship lists' and gives the Postal Service authority over mail-in ballot distribution. The ruling does not represent a final decision on the legality of the order, as the administration seeks to implement these changes ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.

related_stories.title: Trump Proposes 50% Tariffs on Canadian Vehicles Following Trade Talks Breakdown
related_stories.summary: President Trump has threatened to increase tariffs on Canadian vehicles to 50% after trade negotiations failed. He criticized Canada for perceived unfair trade practices, stating that the country has been 'ripping off' the U.S. for years. Economists warn that such tariffs could severely impact Canadian firms and threaten thousands of jobs in Canada.
